messages:
Nina: Quick design review for RBAC + invite flows. Prototype includes: role templates (save/clone), inline permission preview on hover, CSV bulk-invite UX, and conditional SSO copy. Figma: https://redwood.ai/figma/rbac-templates-v1

Carlos: Love the role templates. One ask: show the templates TTL/expiry option when creating invites (admins want ephemeral invites). Maybe a small dropdown next to the email input: Expire in [7 days v] 

Yasmin: Accessibility POV: when the hover preview appears we need an accessible alternative for keyboard/voiceover users (e.g., a focused inline expand). Also color contrast on the SSO badge is failing 4.5:1 in dark mode - raised in ticket #432.

Tom: CSV bulk-invite nit: sample header needs to support `role_id` and `expires_at` columns. Suggest sample in the drawer:

```
email,role_id,expires_at
alice@co.com,team-engineering,2026-06-01
bob@co.com,team-ops,
```

and a small validation summary with inline errors after upload.

Nina: Good call Tom. We'll surface CSV errors inline and add a per-row preview. Also default expiry to 'never' unless specified. For the role preview UX, I prefer an inline expand (enter to toggle) for keyboard users and a hover card for pointer users.

Carlos: SSO copy: currently shows 'SSO required' which is terse. Propose conditional copies based on enforcement:
- enforced: 'This organization requires SSO. Invites will only work with your SSO provider.'
- optional: 'SSO available. Users may sign in with SSO or email.'
Make wording consistent across invite drawer, confirm toast, and audit log entries.

Yasmin: VoiceOver note: when invites are sent the toast should trigger an aria-live="polite" message like '5 invites queued' and later '5 invites processed'. QA flagged flakiness when toasts dismiss before screen reader reads them. Add a role="status" fallback.

DesignBot: Updated prototype v4 pushed: role templates drawer, inline expand for permissions, CSV sample + error UI, conditional SSO copy variants, contrast changes for dark mode. Accessibility checklist updated: keyboard expand toggle, aria-live changes, focus management for CSV upload flow.

QaRobot: QA plan: add tests for bulk upload with malformed rows, screen reader announce tests (VoiceOver, NVDA), keyboard-only flows for role expand/close, and contrast regression tests. Refer to test ticket RED-QA-987.

Tom: Dev FYI: backend needs `invite.expiration` (nullable ISO date), `template_id` on role create, and API flag `feature: rbac_role_templates`. Creating a PR for the invites API: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/789

Nina: One more UI suggestion: audit filter by policy id (admins often search by SSO policy or template_id). Add a small 'Filter by policy/template' token in the advanced filters. Also sticky filter bar so reviewers don't lose context when scrolling.

Carlos: UX microcopy for CSV errors: inline red text 'Row 3: unknown role_id "team-x"'. Keep it brief and machine-copyable for logs.

Yasmin: Accessibility nit: ensure the CSV upload button announces the accepted formats and max file size (aria-describedby). Also ensure focus returns to the upload button if the dialog closes unexpectedly.

Nina: Great feedback. I'll update the mocks and push a condensed spec for engineers (will include keyboard mapping, aria attributes, and copy variants). Thanks everyone :party_popper:
